0.11.6 is a patch of 0.11 and interoperates with 0.11.0 through 0.11.5: format epoch 7, backup format 5, protocol line `11` and every storage, wire and protocol format are unchanged, and the gateway, `ursulactl` and the extension change only their version. Nodes, gateways and extensions of 0.11.0 through 0.11.6 run in one cluster and open, read and import the same streams. Upgrade a cluster in place with an ordinary rolling restart (`helm upgrade`), and the SQLite client by installing `@tonbo/sqlite-ursula` 0.11.6. Rolling back to any earlier 0.11 release is safe.

- **Retention GC deletes only the stream's own cold objects.** Before deleting an object that a cold-index page below the retained offset names, retention GC now checks it as cold GC checks a queued path. It deletes the object only if it is an exclusive chunk or an external payload of that stream, in the stream's own bucket. Any other path stays in the store, a pack included, since a pack holds slices of many streams. So do a snapshot object and another bucket's object. The page and the stream's own objects go as before. Before this release, a corrupt or hand-edited page, or one restored from such a backup, could make retention GC delete them. Each refusal is logged as an error and counted in `cold_gc_foreign_paths_refused`.
- **`collect_retained_cold_objects` is deprecated** in favour of `collect_retained_cold_objects_with_metrics`, which also counts refusals. The deprecated function keeps its signature and applies the same check.
- **A patch release keeps the public API.** CI now checks every change against the newest release of its line: `cargo semver-checks` for the crates, and the export subpaths and names of the npm and Python clients.

Known issues: the known issues of 0.11.0 are unchanged. Every change is listed in the [0.11.6 release notes](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/release-notes#0116).
